goal: Price 20 ErgoMesh 300 task chairs at our three approved vendors and draft a purchase request at the cheapest. Submit it only after I approve.

plan.goal_summary: Quote 20 ErgoMesh 300 task chairs at Ridgeline, Seatwise, and Northgate; draft a purchase request at the lowest-total vendor and submit only after user approval.

steps.intent: Open Ridgeline Office Supply, add 20 ErgoMesh 300 task chairs to cart, and record the displayed order total including shipping.
steps.expected_output: Cart page at Ridgeline showing quantity 20 of ErgoMesh 300 task chairs and a displayed order total including shipping; recorded vendor name, quantity, and order total.

steps.intent: Open Seatwise, add 20 ErgoMesh 300 task chairs to cart, and record the displayed order total including shipping.

steps.intent: Compare the three recorded order totals, open the lowest-total vendor's cart, and fill the purchase request form with the supplied values (Company, Requester name, Work email, Cost center, Delivery address). Leave the filled form open without submitting.
inputs: Lowest-total vendor's cart page URL among the three quote results
steps.expected_output: Purchase request form at the lowest-total vendor's cart, filled with Company, Requester name, Work email, Cost center, and Delivery address, quantity 20 of ErgoMesh 300 task chairs, order total displayed, and form left unsubmitted.

steps.intent: Click Submit on the already-filled purchase request form at the lowest-total vendor and check for a confirmation reference. The system will stop and ask the user for approval before this step runs.
inputs: Existing filled purchase request form page from s4
steps.expected_output: Submitted purchase request with a confirmation reference number displayed on the vendor's confirmation page.
